last.verdict: Teva raised 2026 revenue and brand-drug guidance again as Austedo, Ajovy and Uzedy surged, while shrinking generics and a lowered profit-range ceiling temper the lift.

takeaways.label: Brands drive growth
takeaways.text: Austedo, Ajovy and Uzedy together reached about $1.1 billion in the quarter, up 33%. Ajovy rose 61% and Uzedy 96%.

takeaways.label: Guidance raised, profit capped
takeaways.text: 2026 revenue outlook rose to $16.7–17.0 billion and Austedo to $2.55–2.65 billion. Operating income and EBITDA ceilings were lowered, and the low end of the EPS range barely moved.

takeaways.label: Generics still shrinking
takeaways.text: Total revenue fell 2% to $4.4 billion, mainly on lower sales of generic lenalidomide (a cancer drug). Global generics revenue fell 16%.

takeaways.label: Stronger balance sheet
takeaways.text: Moody's and S&P upgraded Teva to investment grade after Fitch. About $4.9 billion of debt was refinanced; net debt is $12.6 billion.

history.verdict: Stronger brand-drug sales and raised guidance outweighed a profit miss.

reasons.label: Austedo outlook raised
reasons.text: 2026 Austedo sales guidance lifted to $2.45–2.6 billion; U.S. sales up 33%.

reasons.label: Revenue guidance raised
reasons.text: 2026 revenue outlook raised to $16.5–16.85 billion on Austedo, Ajovy and Uzedy.

reasons.label: Miss blamed on deal
reasons.text: Adjusted EPS of 2 cents missed; Emalex acquisition cost about 61 cents per share.
